decisions.quote:
This study presents a three-year replication and extension of Maurer’s (2013) evaluation of a classroom activity
                    to reduce prejudice and discrimination.
decisions.reason: Both the shipped record and blind target 0 identify Maurer (2013), 'Evaluation of a Classroom Exercise on Social Distance and Discrimination' (10.20429/ijsotl.2013.070218), as the original study replicated and extended in this paper. Prior attempts failed quote validation because they reconstructed text across interleaved columns in the introduction rather than quoting a contiguous single-column passage.
